7897.title: Machine launcher selection diverges after updates
7897.rootCauseOneLine: The machine shim selects enrollment npm instead of the maintained launcher, while CLI installation rejects the recognized machine shim.
7897.proposedFix: Review installer-owned shim refresh and current-launcher dispatch while preserving machine-only and multi-installation behavior; packaging changes are outside the autopilot simple-fix gate.
7897.caveats: Dispatch-level executable reproduction with actual installer and server service, not a live upgrade. Original version pair, server move, and Connect authentication symptoms were not reproduced. Same agent repeated verification.
